visible_features: Elevated oblique view shows two visible clock faces on tall square tower, a narrow open upper lantern/pavilion with red hipped tiled roof, and vertical recessed tower bays.
Long main block has pale stone-like vertical frames and horizontal bands, red/brown infill, stacked open colonnade/loggia faces and roof-edge balustrades.
A long rear pitched red-tile roof and projecting roofed end sections are visible, along with a modern-looking partly covered roof terrace.
Large trees obscure some lower-story openings; full back side and exact roof/terrace connections are not shown.
exclusions: Foreground curved ICBC building is separate and not a historic-club facade.
Large white curved Shanghai Grand Theatre behind the club is separate.
The lower red-roof block on the right is not automatically assigned as a historic western wing without independent boundary binding.
geometry_limits: No calibrated pixel-to-metre control; view cannot give exact depth, column grid, clock diameter or full plan.
Only two clock faces are visible; do not state every face/dial mechanism is photographically verified.
Roof terrace fixtures and vegetation may be period-specific; omit or label uncertain alterations.
